chart.empty: No signal data for this period

signal.title: Signal Monitor
signal.summaryGood: Wireless devices: {{count}}, all with a good signal
signal.footer: Signal as the access point hears each device; refreshed every 2 seconds while this page is open.

detail.phoneNote: This is your phone. The signal shown is what the access point hears from it, which can differ from the phone's own reading.
detail.every2s: Updated every 2 seconds, kept only while this page is open
detail.needsPlugin: Install the RouteLink plugin to see signal history, roaming and retries.
detail.roamingNote: Connects and disconnects recorded by every router of the group.

tip.move-closer: The signal is weak. Move the device closer to the access point, or put the access point somewhere more open.
tip.add-ap: If the signal here is often poor, consider adding an access point nearby.
tip.rate-low: The link rate is under half of what this band usually gets: distance, interference or an older device may be the cause.
tip.none: The signal is fine; nothing to do.
tip.unknown: No signal data for this device yet.

roam.none: No connects or disconnects in this period

intruders.title: Who's on My Wi-Fi
intruders.empty: No devices online in this scope

setup.title: Mark your devices first
setup.message: At first every device counts as unknown. Tick the devices you recognise and trust them; from then on only new devices show as unknown.

pick.hint: {{count}} ticked. Ticked devices become trusted, unticked ones are no longer trusted.

intruders.kickTemporary: Kicking is temporary: anyone who knows the password can join again
intruders.localTrust: The trust list is kept on this phone and moves to the router once the plugin is installed.

note.kick: Kicking a device off is temporary: if it knows the password it will join again. Change the Wi-Fi password to keep it out.
note.private: Phones using a private (random) address show no vendor; that alone does not make them intruders.
